# CANDIDATE: RIBBON_SPREAD_FILTER_40C

**Filed:** 2026-08-20  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** filter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup context filter requires ribbon spread ≥ 30 cents to avoid chop. Increasing the minimum ribbon spread to 40 cents will filter out additional low-quality entries on loser days while preserving winners, as winner days tend to have stronger momentum and wider ribbon spreads.

## Mechanism

- Entry gate: For BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON (PUT) setups, require EMA ribbon spread (Slow EMA - Fast EMA) ≥ $0.40 at the trigger bar.
- Exit logic: unchanged (chart-stop primary, chandelier profit-lock, TP1 at +50% premium, runner to ribbon re-entry or 3.0× premium).
- Only affects PUT entries; CALL entries unchanged.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper ~= 14% headline P&L (per risk-rules.md position sizing).
2. **Sample bias:** Stage-1 backtest used 16 months (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18) with 342 trading days. Selection: all PUT entries passing existing filters. Overfit risk: medium (single-parameter change; walk-forward OOS will validate).
3. **Out-of-sample:** Walk-forward OOS (2026-01-02 to 2026-06-18) shows edge_capture = $1,020 (vs baseline $780), Sharpe = 4.85 (vs baseline 4.73), final_score = 4,947 (vs baseline 3,688). PASS.
4. **Real-fills:** Top 3 J days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) validated via cached OPRA real-fills simulator: no change in winner P&L (ribbon spread thresholds met), loser days skipped as predicted. NEEDS-REAL-FILLS for live Alpaca confirmation (paper trading pending).
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: 5/04 extreme vol (ribbon spread >$1.00) — no impact (winner preserved).
   - Max drawdown: unchanged (−$2,273) as winners intact and loser avoidance improves tail risk.
   - Blow-up scenario: persistent low-vol regime (ribbon spread <$0.40) causing missed entries — mitigated by regime-aware override (see pre-merge gate).
6. **Concentration:** Top-5 days = 48% of P&L (baseline 52%); reduced concentration due to fewer low-quality loser-day trades.

## Pre-merge gate

- Gym validators: `test_ribbon_spread_filter_40c.py` 10/10 PASS (including edge-case spread=0.40).
- Walk-forward OOS: WF ratio ≥ 0.70 across all sub-windows (2025Q3, 2025Q4, 2026Q1, 2026Q2).
- Real-fills: Paper trade validation on top 3 J days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) with ≥80% fill rate vs simulated prices.
- Regime guard: In low-vol periods (VIX <15), gate relaxes to ≥$0.30 spread to avoid starvation (configurable via `j_ribbon_spread_floor_low_vol`).
